g.text: Bins are fixed decades of the observed recording increment (0.2 barg; 0.01 ln/min), declared before any error was computed. |Δy| uses the outcome itself, so

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #64748b

g.text: this characterises errors after the fact and is not a deployable gating rule.
